test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for ​₹210.80, a man loses 15%. To gain 9.5%, he should sell it for:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 15% = 3/20

⇒ 17 = 210.80

⇒ 1 = 12.4

⇒ CP = 20 = 12.4 × 20 = 248

To gain 9.5% = 248 + 248 × (9.5/100) = 271.56

∴ The selling price is Rs 271.56

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Formula Used:

CP = SPover 1 -{Lover100} , where

CP = Cost Price

SP = Selling Price

L = Loss%

Calculation:

Substituting the value in the Selling Price equation-

⇒ CP = 210.8over 1 -{15over100} = 210.8 × 20over17 = Rs 248

According to the question-

⇒ New SP = Rs 248 × (1 + 9.5over100) = Rs 271.56

∴ The selling price is Rs 271.56
